subject: [PATCH v4 2/7] mm: allow shared folios to be promoted to a fast tier

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: The patch was acknowledged and accepted without any objections or concerns.

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch series allows shared folios to be promoted to a fast tier, addressing issues with NUMA balancing and memory tiering. It introduces a new function `folio_numab_promotable` to determine whether a folio can be migrated based on its access time and source-tier test. The patch also renames the existing `folio_use_access_time` function to better reflect its purpose.
